#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static long long mod = 998244353LL;
static long long *fact = nullptr;
static long long *revFact = nullptr;

// Fast Fermat Combination
void preFact(int n) {
    fact = new long long[n + 1];
    revFact = new long long[n + 1];
    fact[0] = 1LL;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        fact[i + 1] = (fact[i] * (long long)(i + 1)) % mod;
    }
    revFact[n] = pow_mod(fact[n], mod - 2);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        revFact[i] = (revFact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod;
    }
}

long long cmb(int a, int b) {
    if (a < b) return 0LL;
    if (!fact) {
        std::cerr << "error : factorials has not been calculated!! do [preFact] method\n";
        return 0LL;
    }
    long long af = fact[a];
    long long bf = revFact[b];
    long long abf = revFact[a - b];
    long long res = (af * bf) % mod;
    res = (res * abf) % mod;
    return res;
}

// modular exponentiation
long long pow_mod(long long x, long long y) {
    if (y < 0) return 0LL;
    long long res = 1LL;
    long long base = x % mod;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1) res = (res * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        y >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    preFact(400000);
    int n;
    long long tmp;
    cin >> n >> tmp;

    if (n <= tmp) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    int k = (int)tmp;

    long long ans = 0LL;
    int si = 1;
    long long t = cmb(n, n - k);

    for (int i = n - k; i >= 1; i--) {
        long long term = ( (long long)si * cmb(n - k, i) ) % mod;
        term = (term * pow_mod(i, n)) % mod;
        ans = (ans + term) % mod;
        si *= -1;
    }
    ans = (ans * t) % mod;
    if (k != 0) ans = (ans * 2) % mod;
    cout << ans << "\n";

    // Clean up allocated memory
    delete[] fact;
    delete[] revFact;

    return 0;
}
